data.rationale: Commit 6b3f8857aa moved the invocation of qp_callback in query_planner() from inside the join removal / self-join elimination restart loop to after it. Previously, self-join elimination restarted query_planner after qp_callback had already set Aggref.aggpresorted flags via adjust_group_pathkeys_for_groupagg, which were not reset on restart. The single changed line in planmain.c is already executed by query_planner on every query that invokes planner callbacks, which the baseline grammar already covers at 100% diff-coverage.
seeds: SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1) AS dp, count(DISTINCT a1.c0) AS dq, sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) AS sq FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SELECT a1.c1, count(DISTINCT a1.c0), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 GROUP BY a1.c1 ORDER BY a1.c1;
EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), count(DISTINCT a2.c1), sum(DISTINCT a3.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 JOIN t1 a3 ON a1.c0 = a3.c0;
